metas.name: Bullet Train Explosion
metas.description: A bullet train from Shin Aomori to Tokyo is rigged with a bomb that will explode if speed drops below 100 km per hour. As the attacker demands ransom, the conductor, passengers, and rail staff race to stop a disaster.

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: The Order
metas.description: A series of bank robberies and car heists frightens communities in the Pacific Northwest. A lone FBI agent believes that the crimes were not the work of financially motivated criminals but rather a group of dangerous domestic terr...

metas.name: The Amateur
metas.description: When his supervisors at the CIA refuse to take action after his wife is killed in a London terrorist attack, a decoder takes matters into his own hands.

metas.name: Warfare
metas.description: A platoon of Navy SEALs embark on a dangerous mission in Ramadi, Iraq, with the chaos and brotherhood of war retold through their memories of the event.

metas.name: Drop
metas.description: A widowed mother's first date in years takes a terrifying turn when she's bombarded with anonymous threatening messages on her phone during their upscale dinner, leaving her questioning if her charming date is behind the harassment.

metas.name: Novocaine
metas.description: When the girl of his dreams is kidnapped, a man incapable of feeling physical pain turns his rare condition into an unexpected advantage in the fight to rescue her.

metas.name: Black Bag
metas.description: When intelligence agent Kathryn Woodhouse is suspected of betraying the nation, her husband - also a legendary agent - faces the ultimate test of whether to be loyal to his marriage, or his country.

metas.name: Mickey 17
metas.description: During a human expedition to colonize space, Mickey 17, a so-called "expendable" employee, is sent to explore an ice planet.

metas.name: September 5
metas.description: During the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich, Germany, an American sports broadcasting team must adapt to live coverage of the Israeli athletes being held hostage by a terrorist group.

metas.name: The Gorge
metas.description: Two operatives are appointed to posts in guard towers on opposite sides of a classified gorge.

metas.name: My Fault: London
metas.description: An 18-year-old girl moves from America to London with her mother and wealthy stepfather. When she meets her stepbrother, an attraction sparks despite their efforts. Her estranged father also tracks her down after his release from ...

metas.name: Heart Eyes
metas.description: When two coworkers have to survive the Heart Eyes Killer on Valentine's Day, the two have to find out who it is.

metas.name: Companion
metas.description: A weekend getaway with friends at a remote cabin turns into chaos after it's revealed that one of the guests is not what they seem.

metas.name: The Brutalist
metas.description: A visionary architect flees post-war Europe in 1947 for a brighter future in the United States and finds his life forever changed by a wealthy client.

metas.name: Presence
metas.description: A family becomes convinced they are not alone after moving into their new home in the suburbs.

metas.name: The Whisper Man
metas.description: A grieving father and his young son relocate to the quiet town of Featherbank, which was terrorized by a serial killer known as The Whisper Man 15 years earlier, while rumors circulated that Whisper Man worked with an accomplice.

metas.name: Don't Say Good Luck
metas.description: Sophie Birenbaum gets the lead in her high school show, but at the same time, her mom's cancer comes back.

metas.name: Descendants: Wicked Wonderland
metas.description: The latest installment in the fantasy teen series. When Wonderland plays host to the Kingdom Cup Games, Red and Chloe Charming must fight to save everyone from an unexpected villain.

metas.name: México 86
metas.description: Mexico's improbable bid to host the 1986 World Cup an audacious, against-all-odds feat made possible only by pure Mexican ingenuity.

metas.name: Zeta
metas.description: A Spanish spy must track down a former spy involved in an undercover mission decades ago, while a Colombian agent is also after him. Secrets from the past are uncovered.

metas.name: Rebuilding
metas.description: After wildfires take his ranch, a cowboy named Dusty winds up in a FEMA camp, finding community with others who lost homes, including his daughter and ex-wife.

metas.name: The Thing with Feathers
metas.description: A father and his two young sons dealing with the sudden death of their wife and mother.

metas.name: Matchbox
metas.description: Based on the iconic toy automobiles created in 1953.

metas.name: Hotel Tehran
metas.description: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war torn ex-CIA operators set out to Tehran to take down a life changing score.

metas.name: A Dog's Perfect Christmas
metas.description: A sage basset hound narrates how his family faces turmoil when Mrs. Goss falls into an induced coma, and a new Corgi pup helps unite the scattered household during their mother's absence.
